data-end=\"194\" data-start=\"0\">Owens comes to Southern Miss after a standout 20-year tenure at William Carey University, where he built the Crusaders into one of the NAIA’s top programs. In 2024, he led Carey to a 20-2-1 record, a No. 5 final ranking in the Coaches Top 25 Poll, and the SSAC conference tournament championship, while advancing to the NAIA National Tournament for the 16th time under his leadership. Over the last 20 seasons, Carey posted 18 winning campaigns and compiled a 338-70-19 overall record, along with 12 regular-season conference titles and 11 conference tournament championships. His teams reached four national championship matches, won the 2018 national title, advanced to six Final Fours, and reached the quarterfinals or beyond 11 times.\u003C/p>\r\n\r\n\u003Cp data-end=\"1229\" data-start=\"936\">Owens’ staffs were named National Coaching Staff of the Year in 2018 and 2023, and he has earned multiple regional and conference accolades. Individually, he has coached nine conference players of the year, 16 first-team All-Americans, 56 All-Americans overall, and numerous academic honorees.\u003C/p>\r\n\r\n\u003Cp data-end=\"1596\" data-start=\"1231\">Prior to William Carey, Owens was the head girls’ soccer coach at Our Lady Academy in Bay St. Louis, Mississippi, where his teams won three consecutive state championships.
